No. You need a claimed Yelp Business Account with "Request a Quote" enabled. The Zapier integration for Yelp Leads is completely free. Yelp covers all task costs.

Yes, but a free one works fine. No paid plan needed because Yelp picks up the integration costs.

We have an approval mode for that. You review and edit each AI-drafted response before it sends. Good option when you're first getting started and want to see how the AI handles things.

### Will this work for leads from Yelp.com too, not just ChatGPT?

Yes. Any lead through Request a Quote gets an AI response, whether the customer found you on ChatGPT, the Yelp website, or the Yelp app.

### What if the AI gets something wrong?

The AI only uses information you've actually provided. It won't make up pricing, won't invent availability, won't commit to things you haven't approved. If it's not sure about something, it asks the customer to connect with you directly. You can also add custom FAQs and instructions to guide it.

### What if I already use HireJosie for phone calls?

Then you're basically already set up. Your AI knows your business. Just connect Yelp through the integrations page in your dashboard and you're live. No extra setup.

### How fast does it actually respond?

Under 60 seconds in most cases. Typical responses go out in 10 to 15 seconds.

### What can't the AI do?

It won't commit to specific pricing unless you've told it to. It won't schedule appointments without your calendar integration. And it won't pretend to be human if a customer asks directly. For anything outside its knowledge, it gracefully hands off to you.
